sentences.text: Daniel y Marvin son amigos y viven en Tegucigalpa.
sentences.english: Daniel and Marvin are friends and live in Tegucigalpa.

sentences.text: Hoy van a San Pedro Sula, una ciudad de Honduras.
sentences.english: Today they are going to San Pedro Sula, a city in Honduras.

sentences.text: Van en autobús, porque el viaje es largo.
sentences.english: They go by bus, because the trip is long.

sentences.text: En la terminal, Daniel habla con el empleado.
sentences.english: At the terminal, Daniel talks with the clerk.

sentences.text: —Buenas tardes, señor.
sentences.english: "Good afternoon, sir."

sentences.text: —¿A qué hora sale el autobús para San Pedro Sula?
sentences.english: "What time does the bus to San Pedro Sula leave?"

sentences.text: —Sale en diez minutos, joven —dice el empleado.
sentences.english: "It leaves in ten minutes, young man," says the clerk.

sentences.text: —Entonces quiero dos boletos, por favor.
sentences.english: "Then I would like two tickets, please."

sentences.text: Daniel paga los boletos y llama a su amigo.
sentences.english: Daniel pays for the tickets and calls his friend.

sentences.text: —¡Vení, Marvin, que el autobús ya está aquí! —dice Daniel.
sentences.english: "Come on, Marvin, the bus is already here!" says Daniel.

sentences.text: —¿Vos tenés los boletos? —pregunta Marvin.
sentences.english: "Do you have the tickets?" asks Marvin.

sentences.text: —Sí, aquí los tengo —dice Daniel.
sentences.english: "Yes, I have them here," says Daniel.

sentences.text: Los dos suben al autobús y buscan sus asientos.
sentences.english: The two get on the bus and look for their seats.

sentences.text: —Mirá, hay dos asientos junto a la ventana —dice Marvin.
sentences.english: "Look, there are two seats by the window," says Marvin.

sentences.text: —¿Vos querés la ventana? —pregunta Daniel.
sentences.english: "Do you want the window?" asks Daniel.

sentences.text: —Sí, gracias —dice Marvin.
sentences.english: "Yes, thanks," says Marvin.

sentences.text: El autobús sale de la terminal.
sentences.english: The bus leaves the terminal.

sentences.text: Por la ventana se ven montañas.
sentences.english: Through the window you can see mountains.

sentences.text: —¿Qué hacés en San Pedro Sula? —pregunta Daniel.
sentences.english: "What are you doing in San Pedro Sula?" asks Daniel.

sentences.text: —Voy a visitar a mi abuela, ¿y vos? —dice Marvin.
sentences.english: "I'm going to visit my grandmother, and you?" says Marvin.

sentences.text: —Yo voy a ver a mi tío —dice Daniel.
sentences.english: "I'm going to see my uncle," says Daniel.

sentences.text: —Vos sos un buen sobrino —dice Marvin.
sentences.english: "You are a good nephew," says Marvin.

sentences.text: Los amigos hablan, miran por la ventana y comen algo.
sentences.english: The friends talk, look out of the window and eat something.

sentences.text: Después de varias horas, el autobús llega a San Pedro Sula.
sentences.english: After several hours, the bus arrives in San Pedro Sula.

sentences.text: —Ya llegamos —dice Daniel.
sentences.english: "We're here," says Daniel.

sentences.text: Los dos bajan del autobús y se despiden.
sentences.english: The two get off the bus and say goodbye.

sentences.text: —Cuidate, catracho —dice Marvin.
sentences.english: "Take care, catracho," says Marvin.

sentences.text: —Nos vemos pronto —dice Daniel.
sentences.english: "See you soon," says Daniel.
